aiFactory.title: Learn to Generate Income by
aiFactory.desc: A premium community providing ready-to-use automation templates for solo-entrepreneurs and freelancers. Launch your business and secure your place in the AI revolution.
aiFactory.insideDesc: You copy the systems that earn me money and run them. You don't learn from scratch, you take what already works.
aiFactory.item1Desc: You get the same automations I built for clients and get paid for. Not demos, systems running in the field.
aiFactory.item2Desc: Download and run it right away. You don't build from scratch, you adapt a working system to your own business.
aiFactory.item3Desc: We share the work that comes into the community. Where you learn the system is also where you can sell it.
aiFactory.item4Desc: Not recorded lectures. Live builds, live questions, live fixes.
aiFactory.item5Desc: You ask where you are stuck and you get an answer. It does not sit unanswered in a forum.
aiFactory.not1Desc: We don't cover the history of AI. We build systems that work.
aiFactory.not2Desc: No curriculum that takes a week to watch. You see it built, then you build it.
aiFactory.howDesc: Four steps. You can run your first system the day you join.
aiFactory.step1Desc: You join the community on Skool. The full archive opens the same day.
aiFactory.step2Desc: You pick the ready-made automation that fits your business and download it.
aiFactory.step3Desc: You connect it to your own accounts. If you get stuck, you ask in a live session or one-on-one.
aiFactory.step4Desc: You set the working system up for a business. We share incoming jobs in the community.
aiFactory.a1: A community built so you can copy AI automations and run them in your own business or for your clients. Inside there are proven systems, two live sessions a week and one-on-one Q&A.
aiFactory.a2: 39 dollars a month. Payment and membership are handled on Skool.
aiFactory.q3: Do I need to know how to code?
aiFactory.a3: The systems arrive ready to install. You don't write code from scratch, you connect a working automation to your own accounts. If you get stuck, you get help in the live sessions and in one-on-one Q&A.
aiFactory.q4: Can I ask questions before joining?
aiFactory.a4: Yes. You can write to the WhatsApp pre-sales line on the Skool page.
aiFactory.q5: What if I can't attend the live sessions?
aiFactory.a5: The archive stays in the community. You can also ask one-on-one, so you don't have to wait for a session.
aiFactory.a6: If you're looking for theoretical AI training, this isn't it. There is no academic curriculum and no hours-long lecture videos.
aiFactory.closingDesc: 39 dollars a month. Over 400 people are already inside. Not sure yet? Ask on the WhatsApp line first.
